data.title: 砂狼白子 · 雨夜车站屋檐下的贴近避雨
data.description: 夜雨淅淅沥沥的郊外无人车站屋檐下，潮湿的水汽与泥土香气在冷风中弥漫。白子的短发梢微微带着湿润水汽，她一言不发地贴在老师身侧，小手悄悄拉紧了老师的衣袖，将自己的狼耳轻轻靠在老师肩头。在这方寸庇护所里，两颗心跳声隔着雨声清晰可闻。
data.location: sheltered wooden bench under rainy railway station awning
data.action: standing very close, holding companion sleeve, damp hair, subtle blush, peaceful quiet intimacy
data.lighting: warm glowing station incandescent bulb reflecting on wet rain puddles
data.mood: quiet romantic shelter, silent heartbeat, and breathless closeness
data.promptProse: Sheltered closely under a rain-swept station roof at night, Sunaookami Shiroko clings gently to the viewer sleeve, her damp silver hair and wolf ears bathed in soft lantern glow.
data.animaCaption: Shiroko holding her companion arm close under the dripping station canopy at night.
